title: Subarctic source water at Line P did not carry the 1996-2014 CalCOFI oxygen loss on sigma0 26.5; offshore Line P oxygen stayed level until 2014 and fell after 2015 (bottle data)
abstract: Question: did the California Current import its oxygen loss on the sigma0 = 26.5 density surface (CalCOFI: decline from 1984, then about 16-22 umol/kg low from 2007 to 2025) from its subarctic source water? Approach: the DFO Line P programme samples this source water from the Vancouver Island slope (P4) to Ocean Station Papa (P26). We calculated oxygen on sigma0 = 26.5 from 2,710 DFO-IOS bottle casts at five Line P stations with the same rules as the CalCOFI work, and checked them against GLODAPv2.2023 values of the same casts. We wrote the test plan before we calculated any Line P value. Results: in 2007-2014 CalCOFI oxygen was 22.9 umol/kg (95% interval 21.4 to 24.8) below its 1984-1995 level, but Line P oxygen was at its 1984-1995 level (+2.3, -2.0 to +8.4; offshore stations +7.4; GLODAP casts only -3.4, -9.8 to +0.5). The 1984-2006 Line P trend was -0.27 umol/kg per year (-0.67 to +0.13), against -1.04 at CalCOFI. Lagged Line P oxygen did not forecast the CalCOFI deficit after 2006: the mean 2007-2025 residual was -10.5 umol/kg with Line P oxygen and salinity, against -11.5 with salinity alone. Line P oxygen fell later: by 14.2 umol/kg (10.4 to 19.9) in 2015-2024, with AOU +12.3, solubility -1.9 and saltier, warmer water on the surface. Only the slope station P4 fell with CalCOFI (-0.93 per year in 1984-2006). Interpretation: the CalCOFI loss did not come from the subarctic water of the North Pacific Current; a southern or slope pathway agrees better, but we did not test it. The northeast Pacific lost oxygen on this surface in at least two episodes with different timing. Limitations: sparse offshore Line P sampling in 1985-1996; early IOS oxygen is about 3 umol/kg higher than GLODAP; Line P nutrients are inconsistent; one surface and one section; no model comparison.

(a) Annual values (dots) and 3-year running means (lines) for the CalCOFI core grid, Line P offshore stations (P16, P20, P26) and the Line P slope station P4. (b) Window mean minus the 1984-1995 mean, with 95% moving-block bootstrap intervals, including the Line P series from GLODAP casts only (to 2019).
